# ScholarHat

> > ScholarHat delivers AI-ready tech career training with live instructor-led courses, certifications, and job placement in .NET, Azure, AWS, and emerging technologies.

ScholarHat is a comprehensive tech education platform founded by Microsoft MVPs offering live training, hands-on labs, career transformation programs, and interview preparation resources. The platform specializes in .NET, Azure, AWS, and AI/ML technologies with a strong focus on job placement and career advancement.

## Key Topics

- .NET & C# Development
- Azure Cloud Platform
- ASP.NET Core
- AI/ML Engineering
- Microservices Architecture
- Live Instructor-Led Training
- Certification Courses
- Hands-On Labs
- Career Transformation
- Job Placement
- Interview Preparation
- Full-Stack Development
- DevOps & Cloud
- React & Angular
- Project-Based Learning

## Core Training Programs

- [Live Training Overview](https://www.scholarhat.com/training): ScholarHat live training programs in .NET, Java, DSA, Angular, cloud & AI/ML.
- [.NET AI & ML Engineer Certification](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/net-ai-ml-certification-training): .NET AI & ML certification with ML.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Azure hands-on labs.
- [.NET Developer Certification Course](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/net-certification-training): .NET developer certification course with C#, Visual Studio, hands-on projects.
- [ASP.NET Core Certification Training](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/aspnet-core-certification-training): ASP.NET Core certification with MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, REST APIs.
- [.NET Microservices Certification](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/net-microservices-certification-training): .NET microservices certification with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure deployment.
- [.NET Software Architect Certification](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/software-architecture-design-training): .NET software architect certification with design patterns, microservices.
- [Blazor Certification Training](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/blazor-certification-training): Blazor certification for beginners with components, data binding, web development.
- [Live Training Batch Schedules](https://www.scholarhat.com/training/batches): ScholarHat live training batch schedules for .NET, Azure, AWS, React, DevOps.

## Career Transformation Programs

- [Job Ready Tracks](https://www.scholarhat.com/job-oriented): Job-ready career tracks with .NET, Azure, interview prep by Microsoft MVPs.
- [.NET & Azure Solution Architect Program](https://www.scholarhat.com/job-oriented/net-azure-solution-architect-certification-training): Azure solution architect certification with DevOps, Microsoft Az-305 exam prep.
- [AI-Driven .NET Tech Lead Program](https://www.scholarhat.com/job-oriented/net-tech-lead-certification-training): AI-driven .NET tech lead program with Azure developer certification.
- [AI-Powered Full-Stack .NET Developer Program](https://www.scholarhat.com/job-oriented/full-stack-net-developer-certification-training): Full-stack .NET developer certification with C#, ASP.NET, React, SQL.

## Learning Resources & Support

- [Free Courses](https://www.scholarhat.com/free-course): Free .NET, Azure, AI, ASP.NET Core courses for beginners and certification prep.
- [Master Classes](https://www.scholarhat.com/master-classes): Free master classes on Azure, AWS, AI, microservices by industry experts.
- [Cloud Sandboxes](https://www.scholarhat.com/sandbox): Hands-on cloud sandboxes for Azure, AWS, AI practice environments.
- [Interview Preparation eBooks](https://www.scholarhat.com/books): .NET, Java, AI/ML interview Q&A eBooks by Microsoft MVPs.
- [Skill Assessment Tests](https://www.scholarhat.com/skill-tests): Skill assessment tests for .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Angular, Cloud, Python, SQL.
